description: Care systems lag behind aging and families absorb heavy unpaid burdens.
Fear politics weakens care investment integration public health and social cohesion.
Migrant care labor is essential but insufficiently protected.
Exclusion increases irregularity and weakens integration and service access.
Climate mobility overwhelms housing services and public health in receiving areas.
Youth systems face education employment housing and participation gaps.
Mobility systems improve rights labor pathways integration and public services.
Urban systems invest in housing services care integration and resilience.
